dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

searchable.description: Whether or not the content in this field is searchable in the {@link UiSdlDataGrid} search bar.

label.description: The label displayed in the corresponding column header.

className.description: Optional class to apply to all cells of the column in the grid. For example, you can specify `text-left`, `text-right`, or `text-center` for alignment.

editable.description:
Whether or not this field is editable in a {@link UiSdlDataGrid}; setting to `true` would allows users to edit rows and
save changes.
Nested fields will need to be saved via a custom epic. See SPLY-481.

iconName.description:
Specify an icon name for the column field header.
